incident_text: A brick building partly collapsed after the earthquake. Bricks are lying across the street.

result.scene_summary: A damaged brick building with collapsed upper floors and debris on the street, next to traffic lights and a distant modern skyscraper.

observations.description: Severe damage to a multi-story brick building with exposed wooden beams and missing walls.
Streetlights, traffic signals, and a street corner with white pavement markings.
Cars visible in the distance on the street.
Trees visible in the background behind buildings.
Debris including broken bricks, wooden planks, and a traffic cone on the street.

not_determinable: Scale of damage relative to street
extent of damage to other buildings
